Name: Gifts From Willy - Fisherman's Tales and Fishing Gear
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#4FC3F7]🎣 Willy Sends You Gifts[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][i][color=#90CAF9]From dockside beginner to legend of the sea ⚓[/color][/i][/center]

[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]

[size=4][b]📦 About the Mod[/b][/size]

Receive letters from :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0} as your friendship grows, each one containing useful fishing gear, food, or treasures from the sea.

This mod focuses on:
• 🎣 Meaningful gameplay progression 
• 🌊 Immersive, character-driven rewards 
• 💌 Unique letters with personality 

Willy will guide you from a beginner angler to a true master of the ocean.

[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]

[size=4][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

• 📬 Gifts by friendship level (1–10 hearts) 
• 🎣 Fishing-focused progression (bait, tackle, food) 
• 🧓 Immersive “old fisherman” dialogue style 
• 🌍 Full i18n support (multiple languages) 
• ⚖️ Balanced rewards (no useless items) 


[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]

[size=4][b]⚙️ Installation[/b][/size]

1. Download the mod from Nexus Mods 
2. Extract into your Stardew Valley Mods folder 
3. Run the game using SMAPI 
4. Enjoy!
